decision: The prior-date TWSE institutional source files are current-contract facts and all three source states are available. Recheck confirms these are no longer publication-timing uncertainties. Preserve actor semantics from facts: no_record means a valid official daily actor table has no row for the stock; zero_net means an official source row exists with net exactly zero. Do not coerce no_record to numeric zero.

web_verification.summary: TWSE official pages confirm historical daily institutional-investor queries are available and the combined three-institution daily report explicitly exposes foreign, investment-trust and dealer net fields. Together with the same-date facts source status (foreign/trust/dealer all available), the unresolved publication question is resolved.
